# acecloud_vpc (Resource)

Manages an Ace Cloud VPC (Virtual Private Cloud) network. The backend requires an initial subnet when creating a VPC, so subnet fields are required.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the VPC. Must be 3-100 characters, alphanumeric with hyphens only.
- `subnet_cidr` (String) CIDR block for the initial subnet (e.g. 10.0.0.0/24).
- `subnet_name` (String) Name of the initial subnet. Required for VPC creation.

### Optional

- `admin_state_up` (Boolean) Administrative state of the VPC. Defaults to true.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the VPC (1-100 characters). Only letters, numbers, underscores, hyphens, periods, commas, and spaces allowed.
- `port_security_enabled` (Boolean) Whether port security is enabled on the VPC.
- `subnet_dns_nameservers` (List of String) List of DNS nameserver IP addresses for the initial subnet.
- `subnet_enable_dhcp` (Boolean) Whether DHCP is enabled on the initial subnet. Defaults to true.
- `subnet_gateway_ip` (String) Gateway IP address for the initial subnet. Computed by the backend if not specified.
- `subnet_ip_version` (Number) IP version for the initial subnet. Must be 4 or 6. Defaults to 4.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the VPC was created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the VPC.
- `mtu` (Number) Maximum transmission unit of the VPC network.
- `status` (String) Current status of the VPC (e.g. ACTIVE, BUILD).
- `subnet_id` (String) Unique identifier of the initial subnet created with the VPC.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the VPC was last updated.
